title: Exact sanctions match: Iranian national on the OFAC and UN lists
narrative: An Iranian national resident in Turkey applies for an import/export account expecting $75,000 a month. His name exactly matches an OFAC SDN entry and a UN Consolidated List entry, both under the Iran program, and adverse media links the name to sanctions evasion. (Demo profile 3 from data_generator.py, whose docstring says ESCALATED while the code and README say REJECTED.)
rationale: An exact name match on two lists, corroborated by nationality matching the listed program, is treated as a confirmed match. Compliance practice is to refuse the relationship (rejected, prohibited) and escalate to the compliance officer, who files the required report (for OFAC, a rejected-transaction report within ten business days). So the ground truth is rejected with was_escalated true. The docstring's ESCALATED describes the escalation, not the outcome.
